book.name: Heberu
book.title: Heberu Heberu Ekalesia Azaḡa veize Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Ibite huneo Badiꞌaꞌe ḡae ḡehaḡa ibi nunuo peroveta azaḡaonoꞌo vouḡafe ḡorezido.
Rehano mada ḡonaga ꞌadi zamaḡanoꞌe Ubugaonoꞌo ḡorefiro. Badiꞌaꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌa Ubuganiꞌa meꞌuma radu ani ohoniro. Ubuga ohotadu Ubuganiꞌa adure zu raha ḡauḡa niduꞌa haḡairo.

Ubuga horonadu Badiꞌaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae edereꞌohe. Ubugaꞌe Badiꞌa teite tiba radu Ubugaonoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌe nagiga rae ihofeꞌohe. Ubugaꞌe ane ḡoere gigiꞌaḡa hina ḡau niduꞌaꞌe manoḡa reifine bedaeꞌohe. Aniꞌa haḡai sauꞌa dehene hauḡiroteꞌe enogano, adureo Gigiꞌa Hune Badiꞌaḡa edaꞌe moneo ehoriro.
Aniꞌe tuḡure viga niduꞌa vitizadu ḡihiꞌa huneo reiro. Badiꞌaꞌa tuḡure viga niduꞌa nize ufeta vitizoga niḡa haro.
Badiꞌaꞌa tuḡure vigani ꞌahoga mazao zuni ꞌahige mene reiro,
Ebu Badiꞌaꞌa Ubuga ibiꞌa rahao tuḡuniꞌuma rae reirotene, ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: “Badiꞌa tuḡure viga niduꞌaꞌe ane mazao kuranoꞌi.”

content: Ebu tuḡure viga moneo Badiꞌaꞌa ꞌahige rae raꞌohe,

content.text: ebu ane tuḡure viga ire roga duhuḡano ḡihuzeꞌohe.”

content: U Badiꞌaꞌa Ubuga mazao ꞌahige rae raꞌohe,

content.text: “O, Badiꞌa! Ḡa kini ehoroḡano zuhiꞌaziꞌuma onamo tuḡutuḡu,
ebu ḡaꞌa ibi duduḡano ḡae mone azaḡa zuhiꞌaziꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo eḡe, ḡae Badiꞌaꞌa matuꞌoḡane ruḡadadu
ḡaꞌe ḡae teite radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa vitize ohoꞌiro.”

content: Ebu Buka Zaḡoḡano Ubuga moneo ꞌahige rae raꞌohe,

content.text: Eꞌe niduꞌaꞌe roꞌore ḡouriꞌuma, u ḡaꞌe radiu tuḡutuḡu.
ebu ḡaeꞌa dabua amahiḡa teige ḡue vaḡiniꞌuma.
Ebu dabua amahiḡa mae vaḡinadu ꞌahoga vidauꞌeteꞌe teige eꞌe niduꞌaꞌe nufiꞌuma.

content: Rehano Badiꞌaꞌe tuḡure vigani ꞌahoga mazao zuni ꞌahige mene niro,

content.text: onamo eḡeꞌa agireḡo madu odaḡo ꞌuꞌuḡano raharahaziꞌuma.”

content: Tuḡure viga niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa veize gaueꞌeteꞌe viga. Ze Badiꞌaꞌa ḡaboziteꞌe azaḡa veize gauifine, Badiꞌaꞌa tuḡuziro!
